body: Test fixture, not real work. This thread existed to exercise the 6.0.0 hand-off path end to end on the live server: open_thread with artifacts, record_decision, log_session_event, update_thread with criteria_done, artifacts_add, artifacts_retire, risks_add and risks_retire, then park_thread with outcome, landed and next_step, then resume_thread. Every one of those behaved as the spec says. Two findings came out of it and are reported to the human: close_thread does not release the active-thread pointer, and record_decision given a criterion_id but no scope renders an empty scope label on the spine rather than deriving criterion N. The rate-limiting project it describes does not exist.
